Results.ReviewText:
This is my first propane grill after having owned a Weber Kettle for several years. I wanted to move to LP because of the faster grill times, easy cleanup, and the repeated purchasing of charcoal was adding up. Overall I am very satisfied with this model and am glad I made the switch.

The assembly was very intuitive and straightforward. The components seem very well designed and look like they will last a long time

We have already grilled a number of different foods on this unit, and so far the grilling process has been very pleasant and virtually foolproof. The startup is fast, the burners are responsive, and the temperature is easy to control. The cleanup of the cast-iron grates is amazingly fast compared to the charcoal approach, and the stainless steel exterior is easy to wipe down.

I was searching for a great no-frills propane grill and am very satisfied with this purchase.
Results.Title: No regrets

Results.ReviewText: I purchased a Weber Spirit E-210 in 2014. Nine years on and it was time to be replaced. I considered other types of grills / smokers, but eventually came back to Weber. This time, though, I upgraded to the Spirit E-310. After using the E-210 for a while, I concluded that I needed more heat. I have one disappointment though. The E-210 has collapsible side tables. The E-310 does not. My bad for not checking in advance of purchase. I assumed the only difference between the two models was an additional burner. I’ll live with it though.

ClientResponses.Response:
We appreciate your feedback. We are so sorry to hear about your prior experience with corrosion. We are happy to provide some suggestions going forward to help you get a long life out of your new grill!
 
If your grill is located in a coastal or humid area, or if chlorine is present in your environment, additional maintenance will be needed to keep up the appearance of the exterior steel parts. 

  At the first sign of staining/discoloration/surface rust we would recommend cleaning with stainless steel cleaner (ex. Bar Keepers Friend). Once cleaned, we recommend using a stainless steel polish (ex. Weber's brand) to keep it looking its best in-between cleanings.
 
Once a week we would recommend wiping down the grill with a wet towel or rag and then drying completely.
 
We would only recommend covering your grill if you know inclement weather is coming.
 
The quicker you get at a stain the easier it will be to clean off.

Our Care team will be reaching out to follow up. Please look for our outreach soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Easy assembly, easy to use and works perfectly. Very happy with this little guy!

Results.ReviewText: The tank fill spring mechanism doesn't always register accurately. As a result you may have to "bounce" the tank to get the scale to read correctly. I had a new tank and it registered 1/3 full upon initial installation. After bouncing the tank, it registered correctly. I would like if the wings (or at least one of them) was able to be folded down. I really enjoy the reversible grill grates and the grease collection system. In general, I'm happy with the grill. It was easy to assemble with clear instructions.
Results.Title: Good w/ small flaws.

Results.ReviewText: Overall, a wonderful gas grill. Easy to assemble and appears very well built. The grill ignites quickly and heats to temperature in approximately 10 minutes. The grates clean easily and leave nice "grill marks". The grill loose heat quickly but the burners can recover with adjustment.
Results.Title: Nice grill for it's size.

Results.ReviewText: Very hot grill. With 3 burners, it's tough to get the temperature to hold a lower temperature (350). That said, it's fast and efficient, and provides even heat. I really like the cabinet that hides the drip pans and the propane, but the propane tank was very difficult to mount on the hanger inside the cabinet.
Results.Title: Hot grill, cabinet both helps and hinders.

46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
